nom: Bioderma Sensibio Foaming Gel Face Cleanser for Sensitive Skin

avis.texte: I used to use the cerave green bottle and it did not get remove my makeup or sunscreen. Since switching to this face wash I've stopped breaking out as much. The product is gentle yet still leaves your skin clean. Will forever keep repurchasing 🩷

avis.titre: Picked up on clearance and have bought 4x since
avis.texte: Very gentle while actually removing make up. Also hydrating to dry skin especially in the winter. I actually will never buy a different face wash.

As someone with very sensitive acne prone skin, this is the best cleanser ive ever used. Ive tried all the cleansing waters / balms / oils and this is definitely the one that best cleansing off any makeup or sunscreen that i may be wearing with aggressively stripping and drying my skin. This does not remove watter proof makeup but regardless is great and has helped my skin alot.

I just bought this on a whim. It almost has the texture of Prequel cleansers with a light foam. My feels feels but not dry. Its a huge bottle for the price but im concerned that i wont use it all in the 6 month deadline. It says it good for t mos after opening
I bought this for the third time. There are very few cleansers I can use due to my dry acne prone skin. It doesn't dry out my skin and is very gentle.
I just grabbed this on a whim. And i love. It feels so nice on my skin. My face is squeaky clean but not drying. I like it better than the other popular brands. Please never discontinue

I bought this product as I didn't see it had any pore cloggers or fragrances. I used it for about a week to give it a good test, and my skin looks terrible. I broke out all over my cheeks and chin with small bumps and my face looks dry

This cleanser doesn't dry out my skin and has no smell! It's works great as an only cleanser or your 2nd cleanse after removing make with and oil based cleanser as it really does remove everything well. You get a decent amount of product in the bottle and there are not many ingredients to irritate the skin.

I have highly sensitive skin but read reviews and thought this would be a good cleanser to try. Unfortunately I had a reaction with the first use and had rough red patches across my face. I thought the cleanser was nice but it just didn't work for me.

I purchased this to use in a two step cleansing routine. It does a good job removing makeup on its own, including regular mascara (very gentle on eyes). While it removes a lot of makeup, it had trouble removing my water resistant daily mineral sunscreen. I have to double cleanse to remove the sunscreen. I plan to repurchase this fantastic cleanser.
Great cleanser for sensitive skin. Does not dry out my skin, and no annoying fragrance which I love!

I'm pleased with the results and consistency of this cleanser! I used to only use Dermalogica Cleansers, not only because I liked the brand but for the results I saw within my skin. I wanted to try something more budget friendly and suitable for sensitive skin, hand down I will be purchasing this again!!!

As someone with sensitive, dry, acne prone skin i have been searching for a good makeup remover. I tried all the oils, cleansing balms, miceller waters and this is by far my favorite!! It takes off my makeup well without stripping my skin or leaving it dry and tight. My skin always looks better after using this product.

This is my new go to in cleanser as well as the Micellar water I purchased from Bioderma. The skin around my eyes had been extra dry, watery and wrinkled up from the aftermath of fires this past winter. For years, I was using Garnier micellar with Aloe Vera but now Bioderma is my go to brand in both cleanser and Micellar water- A little goes a long way and it is cost effective.

I bought fhis after seeing MakeupByMelissa show it as a one stop cleanser instead of having to tske off makeup AND double cleanse. This does all 3. I was using Cerave and it never felt it got everything off. This does and becomes frothy while cleansing the entire face, no makeup left and doesnt dry my face out. I noticed a difference immediately because my face was actually getting clean for me to then use toners, serums, etc. Buy it.

Bought this for my teen daughter after reading good reviews and seeing ingredient list was free of her contact allergens. Also like that it's fragrance free and a large bottle for the price. Unfortunately it caused terrible acne breakout all over her face. We're going back to Vanicream cleanser for her sensitive skin.

This is by far my favorite cleanser I've ever used. I have extremely sensitive dry/combination skin. I've been on the hunt for an inexpensive and basic cleanser that truly leaves my face clean. This is it! My skin hates oil cleansers, so my favorite thing about this is I don't need to double cleanse. My face feels so clean after using, yet it doesn't feel dry or stripped. This is the perfect basic cleanser and you get a ton of product so this bottle will probably last months. I occasionally get hormonal acne and this has helped clear it up. I have nothing negative to say about this cleanser. Definitely give it a try!
Unfortunately broke me out. I believe it's the last ingredient in the list, however, this was a very gentle wash otherwise. It lathered up nicely and left my skin silky smooth!

avis.titre: Tough on makeup, gentle on skin!
avis.texte: I have very sensitive, dry skin and this micellar foaming cleanser is by far the best cleanser I have used! It great in removing makeup, leaving my skin feeling clean, yet doesn't dry it up like most other cleaners do. Love the micellar water as well! Such a dynamic duo!
Im very sensitive and this cleanser didn't irritate my skin. It definitely removes your makeup and i triple cleanse and my skin felt hydrated. Would purchase again.
Im very sensitive and this cleanser didn't irritate my skin. It definitely removes your makeup and i triple cleanse and my skin felt hydrated. Would purchase again.
